decks.notes: This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption through cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize. The key strategy is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Amped Raptor, while also using Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment for additional reach and removal. The mana base provides a good mix of colors to support the aggressive game plan, while cards like Voice of Victory and Guide of Souls help to maintain card advantage and board presence throughout the game.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures and spells to win the game using the combo of Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, milling the entire library and then using Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle for a win. The deck features many fast mana accelerators like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to quickly set up the combo and disrupt the opponent's plans with cards like Cabal Therapy and Pact of Negation. The goal is to win the game in one explosive turn before the opponent can react.

The main concept of this deck is to use Urza's Workshop and Ancient Tomb to generate a lot of mana quickly, allowing you to cast powerful artifacts like Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator. By using cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Kozilek's Command to control the board, and cards like Manifold Key and Voltaic Key to untap your artifacts for extra value, you can set up a strong board state and overwhelm your opponent. The deck aims to create a powerful combo engine using artifacts to control the game and win in the late game.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bringing them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces. The deck's win condition is to reanimate creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruptive elements like Wasteland and Brazen Borrower to control the board and hinder the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupt their game plan with cards like Wasteland and Chalice of the Void. The deck aims to play aggressive creatures like Eldrazi Linebreaker and Thought-Knot Seer early on, while also utilizing powerful mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Grim Monolith to cast big threats like Reality Smasher. The inclusion of cards like Eye of Ugin and Cavern of Souls helps to make casting Eldrazi creatures more efficient and difficult for the opponent to deal with.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts such as cards like Mystic Forge, Grim Monolith, and Karn, the Great Creator to generate massive amounts of mana and assemble powerful combos quickly. It also includes various artifacts like Basalt Monolith and Manifold Key to help ramp up resources effectively. The deck aims to establish board control and outvalue opponents by efficiently manipulating artifacts on the battlefield. The synergy between the artifacts and cards like Tezzeret, Cruel Captain allows the deck to achieve its win conditions rapidly and consistently in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck revolves around assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire library. It also utilizes artifacts like Urza's Tower and Grim Monolith for ramp and mana acceleration, as well as Tezzeret, Cruel Captain and Karn, the Great Creator for additional utility and control. The goal is to set up a quick win condition by manipulating artifacts and control the board with various artifact synergies.

The deck focuses on filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then quickly bringing them back to the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. Using spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to disrupt opponents' strategies, while also utilizing powerful card draw with Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. With a mix of control elements like Force of Will and removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful reanimated creatures.

The deck focuses on a high-risk, high-reward combo strategy that aims to win the game in one explosive turn by milling the entire library and then casting Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. The deck utilizes a combination of fast mana, efficient discard spells, and powerful graveyard recursion to quickly assemble the combo and prevent disruption from the opponent. The key is to carefully manage resources and timing to execute the combo successfully while navigating through potential counterplays from the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back to the battlefield for an explosive combo finish. It also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and control the opponent's strategy. The deck is built around efficiently reanimating big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier while also having options for alternative win conditions with cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to all colors needed for the combo.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures. By using cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer to disrupt the opponent's spells and hand, combined with powerful beaters like Reality Smasher and Devourer of Destiny, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized for fast mana acceleration and consistency in casting Eldrazi spells, making it a resilient and aggressive strategy in the Legacy format.

The deck focuses on using powerful reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to cheat big creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly. It also includes strong control elements like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent with huge threats while keeping them in check with counterspells and disruption. It's a high-risk, high-reward strategy that can win games in a single explosive turn.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their strategy with cards like Chalice of the Void, Magus of the Moon, and Blood Moon. This allows the deck to quickly deploy threats like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf to apply pressure and close out the game. The deck also has powerful removal options like Fury and Sundering Eruption to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and The One Ring provide additional utility and card advantage to help maintain momentum in the game.

The main focus of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void, while also deploying aggressive threats like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck aims to apply pressure early on and finish off opponents with powerful burn spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption. The inclusion of utility cards like Soul-Guide Lantern, Pithing Needle, and The One Ring provide versatility and answers to a variety of threats. Overall, the deck seeks to control the game through disruption and aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By using cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also generating card advantage through cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Snapcaster Mage. Additionally, the deck includes threats like Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent and close out the game. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to the deck's powerful spells and abilities.
